reviews.title: Miserable Customer Service
reviews.text: I’ve been trying to get an issue fixed for over a month, but customer service keeps giving me the runaround. All I want to be able to do is correct my distances when I run on a treadmill, but the app only accepts commas for decimals, and a United States keyboard only offers digits and the decimal point. The reps don’t even bother reading my actual complaint, and instead seem to be trying to follow a script that was never intended to be used for my issue. I’m starting to think the rep who emails me is actually a chatbot, and not a human being.

reviews.title: Living a Better Life
reviews.text: Back in July of 2024, I was pushing 270lbs. I was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes and I started sleeping with a CPAP machine. Then one day, I looked myself in the mirror and said enough is enough. I started with C25K and used that several times before switching to 10K Trainer. It mirrors the C25K app, but there is more features to enjoy in the 10K. Today, I am 193 lbs and still loosing weight. My blood work doesn’t even show me as pre-diabetic anymore, and I no longer sleep with a CPAP machine. For me, it was about ownership over my own health and taking responsibility over the things I can control. I love and respect myself more each and every day because of the decisions I have made. Thank you to C25K/10K family and beyond. What’s your story?!?

reviews.title: Very Basic “Training Plan”
reviews.text: I’d seen such good reviews I went ahead and paid for a subscription, but I’m very disappointed. As you progress, the intervals disappear and most weeks are just repeating “Run 2.5 miles (or 25 minutes)”. Chat came up with more creative plans than that. Additionally, there is no consideration of pace & distance runs are based on a 10 min mile.
